definitions.explanation: Having to do with art or showing artistic quality; also high praise for skill in any field, as if the thing were a work of art.

examples.japanese: {芸術的|げいじゅつてき}な⟦{作品|さくひん}→作品：02776_sakuhin⟧。
⟦{彼女|かのじょ}→彼女：01286_kanojo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芸術的|げいじゅつてき}な⟦センス→センス：10468_sensu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ゴール→ゴール：03845_gooru⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{芸術的|げいじゅつてき}で、⟦{観客|かんきゃく}→観客：02556_kankyaku⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{息|いき}→息：02176_iki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧のんだ。
examples.english: His goal was a work of art, and the whole crowd gasped.

notes:
USAGE:
- Of art itself: {芸術的|げいじゅつてき}な⟦{価値|かち}→価値：00131_kachi⟧ (artistic value), {芸術的|げいじゅつてき}⟦センス→センス：10468_sensu⟧ (an eye for art)
- As praise for skill in anything: a goal, a dish or a repair can be {芸術的|げいじゅつてき} (masterly, a work of art)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{芸術|げいじゅつ}→芸術：02712_geijutsu⟧: art
- {芸術性|げいじゅつせい}: artistry, artistic quality
- {美的|びてき}: aesthetic, concerning beauty rather than art
